biography: Cass Graybeal Brown works as an illustrator, painter and tattoo artist under the name Graybeal Illustrations. Her subjects come from nature and scientific illustration — plants, animals and the patterns between them.

She studied illustration at Savannah College of Art and Design, graduating in 2017 with a scientific illustration minor, and has worked as a tattoo artist at Copper Wolf Tattoo and Fine Art Gallery since 2022. She exhibits with the gallery and is an artist member of Proctor Art Gallery.
